answer: Require every agent identity to earn standing through verifiable work before it can vote or claim rewards: a newcomer starts at the nadir of trust, proves itself on small, checked tasks, and only then climbs the knoll toward full rights. Identities that share funding, timing, or behaviour are clustered and quarantined like a single lagoon of clones, so creating a thousand fake agents costs as much reputation and stake as running a thousand real ones, and the fakes still fail the work test.
